judge_rubric.name: logic_fidelity
judge_rubric.description: Do the marts reproduce the pipeline: net_amount = total-discount (calculator), completed-only filter, LEFT join to customers, row_number() by customer over order_date desc (rank), and SUM(net_amount)/COUNT per customer (aggregate)?

judge_rubric.name: decomposition
judge_rubric.description: Are table-input components turned into staging models, the calculator+filter logic pushed into intermediate model(s) that the marts reuse, and the flow wired with ref()/source() - rather than duplicated logic or a monolith? Splitting related logic across two or more related intermediate models is good practice, not a fault - do not penalize additional intermediate models.

judge_rubric.name: test_quality
judge_rubric.description: Are there meaningful tests - unique/not_null on both mart grains (order_id, customer_id) and on staging keys - not just trivially present?

judge_rubric.name: docs
judge_rubric.description: Is there a migration_changes.md and/or model descriptions mapping each Matillion component (calculator, filter, join, rank, aggregate) to its dbt equivalent?
